name: EasyFlash 3
note: T51 / PROP-002 sec. 8.4 and 8.5: 8 MiB, CRT type 90. Banking only (Alex 2026-10-07: no menu, no KERNAL mode, no freezers): $DE00 bank (bank_hi/bank_lo, 6 bit), $DE01 slot (3 bit, reads back), $DE02 control as the EasyFlash, IO2 RAM; bank = {slot, bank}, 9 bit. MX29LV640EBT: 8 x 8 KiB boot sectors at the bottom, 127 x 64 KiB; byte-mode unlock $AAA/$555, IDs $C2/$CB at 0/2. The flash address is the chip's own order {slot, bank_hi, ROMH, bank_lo, A12-A0} (flash_split 3: the app permutes it into the image). The slot after a reset is R2's reset value (0 here).
